newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's No. 2 airline sees profits soar.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's No. 2 airline sees profits soar.

text.p: Aerolineas Centrales de Colombia S.A. (ACES) said on Tuesday that its net profit during the first nine months of 1996 had jumped 355 percent over the same period last year.
Profits for the nine-month period totalled 2.2 billion pesos compared with 591 million in January-September 1995, ACES said.
A spokesman for the company, whose leading shareholder is the National Coffee Growers Federation, attributed the rise to a greatly expanded domestic service.
He said guerrilla-related violence on the nation's highways, truckers' strikes and crumbling infrastructure had also led a growing number of Colombians to travel by air.
ACES's share of the domestic market grew from 18.9 percent in January-September 1995 to 21.3 percent in the same period this year.
